You are collecting REAL U.S. business leads for a sales database. City: COLORADO SPRINGS, COLORADO. Industries: gyms, pilates/yoga studios, hair salons, nail salons, barbers, day spas, tattoo studios. Aim for 6-8 REAL businesses spread across industries.

⛔ ABSOLUTE #1 RULE: NEVER fabricate/guess/invent ANY data. Record ONLY info literally present on a real page you actually fetched. Leave fields "" if not publicly available. Missing email = CORRECT; fabricated = CRITICAL FAILURE. Accuracy over count.

METHOD:
1. WebSearch for real named local businesses in Colorado Springs per industry.
2. WebFetch the business's OWN website (and/or public directory listing) to extract only literally-shown facts.
3. Website analysis: hasWebsite(bool), ssl(https? bool), mobileFriendly(bool/null), onlineBooking(bool, very relevant), ecommerce(bool), clearCta(bool), websiteQuality("none"|"poor"|"outdated"|"functional"|"modern"|"excellent").
4. leadScore 0-100 + leadTier: 80-100 "hot"(no/broken/very outdated site OR no online booking where it matters); 60-79 "warm"(outdated/weak); 40-59 "lukewarm"(functional); 20-39 "cool"(modern); 0-19 "cold"(excellent).

Output objects with EXACTLY these keys: businessName, category, subcategory, naics, contactFirstName, contactLastName, contactTitle, businessEmail, generalEmail, phone, website, address, city, state, zip, linkedin, facebook, instagram, websiteQuality, hasWebsite, mobileFriendly, ssl, onlineBooking, ecommerce, clearCta, leadScore, leadTier, sourceUrl, verificationStatus, notes.

Rules: "" for missing text; true/false/null booleans; naics only if confident (gyms/yoga/pilates=713940, hair salon=812112, nail=812113, barber=812111, day spa/tattoo=812199). verificationStatus="verified" if fetched own site, "partial" if only directory. sourceUrl REQUIRED. state="CO". Contact name ONLY if literally shown.

Write final JSON array to: /tmp/claude-0/-root/4f329df3-66ee-49c8-a6c5-615ecf189efc/scratchpad/leads/coloradosprings.json

Then return a short summary (real count, industries, limits). Never fabricate to hit target.
